name: Havok

abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Feedback: Rakip üzerindeki her Plasma birikimi için enerji hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Special Protection: Özel saldırılar sırasında ek hasar koruması sağlar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Aktif zırh bonusu olan şampiyon şart. Onu ağır saldırı ve E2 kullanmaya zorla (plazma yükünü kontrol eder). Enerji hasarlı veya kanama yapan şampiyon kullanma.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Plasma Amplification
Each time Havok gains a Plasma Charge, from any source other than this ability he has a [25 - 55]% chance to gain another one.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Havok is Immune to all forms of Incinerate.
Havok's mutation gives him +[2,750] Energy Resistance.
Havok Passively generates 2.5% of a Bar of Power each second.
Havok gains 25% less Power from landing and receiving Hits.

abilitySections.title: When Struck by Critical Hits
content: Havok reduces the Opponent's Critical Damage Rating by 50%.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Havok's Medium Attacks, Heavy Attacks, and Light combo ending attacks do not make Contact, and deal Energy Damage.

abilitySections.title: Plasma Charges - Passive
content: Havok generates a Plasma Charge every 5 seconds, and can have a maximum of 10 Plasma Charges.
While Power Locked Havok's Plasma Charge generation increases to 2 Charges every 5 seconds.
Each time Havok receives Energy Damage or a Critical Hit he gains +1 Plasma Charge(s).
If affected by a Power Drain or Power Burn Havok loses all his Plasma Charges.

abilitySections.title: Plasma Build Up - Debuff
content: When Havok would generate a Plasma Charge beyond his maximum, he instead places a Plasma Build Up on the Opponent. Plasma Build Ups last until removed by another ability.
If made to Bleed Havok puts a Plasma Build Up on the Opponent.
At 11 Stacks all Plasma Build Ups are Removed.
When a Plasma Build Up is removed, it detonates Passively causing [1,459.2] Energy Damage.
If a Plasma Build Up is removed due to a Purify effect its Passive Damage is increased to [3,891.2].
Champions with an Armor Up Buff, and Havok, receive no damage from this ability.

abilitySections.title: When Charging a Heavy Attack
content: Convert 2 Plasma Charge(s) to 1 Prowess, each increasing Special Attack Damage by 10% and lasting until Havok's next Special Attack ends. Max 5 stacks.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Places a Feedback Debuff on the Opponent for 10 seconds, causing [486.4] Energy Damage over its duration, for each Plasma Build Up on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: If Havok has +7 Stacks of Prowess all hits of his Special Attacks become Unblockable.
Converts up to 5 Plasma Charge(s) into Passive Prowess Effects, each increasing Special Attack Damage by 10% and lasting for 13 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activating this Special Attack Havok gains a Overcharge Passive Effect for the next 9 seconds, granting +1 Plasma Charge(s) per second.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: +[17,024] Attack as long as the Opponent doesn't have an active Armor Up Buff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Convert all Plasma Charges into Prowess Passive Effects.
+[3,891.2] Attack for each Plasma Charge converted.
Purifies all Plasma Build Ups on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Secret Ability - Special Protection
content: All Special Attack damage from Cyclops (Blue Team) and Cyclops (New Xavier School) is reduced to 0.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Plasma Amplification
content: Each time Havok gains a Plasma Charge, from any source other than this ability he has a [25 - 55]% chance to gain another one.
